title: First birthday cake near Rydalmere or Toongabbie? 100% eggless, 6-inch from $39.99
summary:
A first birthday cake for Rydalmere, Northmead and Toongabbie families, made 100% eggless in Harris Park.

A 1-year-old's first taste of cake should not come with a question about eggs. Here, there are none. Not in the sponge, not in the buttercream, not in any of our 15 flavours.

The 6-inch starts at $39.99 and serves 6-8, which is the right size for a family lunch. It is fresh to order, which is why we ask for 48 hours' notice. Pickup from Wigram Street, open daily 11am to 10pm.

Send a photo of the design you have in mind on WhatsApp +61 425 697 725 and we will recreate it. The baby will not remember it. Everyone else will.
